text:
Japan’s inflation- and PPP-adjusted GDP per capita rose to about **12 times its 1950 level** by 2016—an increase of roughly **1,120%**, from about $3,062 to $37,385 in 2011 international dollars, using the [Maddison Project’s 2023 series](https://huggingface.co/datasets/yuiseki/maddison-project/blob/main/README.md).
